text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, you first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. That is the time Slack shows, and the channel doesn't give a timezone.

Your 10:42 post said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. It also said the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. The channel doesn't say when the guard stopped using the clipboard.

At 11:03 Mateo posted that kiosk 1 was back and the guard had checked in trailer 8836. At 11:08 you posted that both lanes were working as of 11:07. That makes the outage about 25 minutes by my own estimate, from your first report to your all-clear.

I posted this in the thread. My first message wrongly said "Central, UTC-5" and said the guard was still on the clipboard at 11:03, so I posted a correction. The version above is the accurate one.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text:
